readings.title: After the photograph of the planting day
readings.instruction: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A company proudly shared photographs of employees planting trees near a walking path. Six months later, a volunteer noticed that several young trees were leaning and others had disappeared beneath weeds. The original budget had covered planting but no follow-up care. The company and a local group agreed on a maintenance schedule and named a contact person. They also recorded which trees survived through the next summer. The later report contained fewer dramatic photographs but more useful information. It showed that the value of the project depended on what happened after the public event.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：篇章结构与信息判断

readings.title: A bin placed where people paused
readings.instruction: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A park had litter bins near its entrances, yet food wrappers collected beside a bench overlooking the pond. Staff first added a notice asking visitors to behave responsibly. The wrappers remained. Observations showed that many people ate snacks at the bench before continuing along a path that did not pass an entrance. Staff moved one bin closer to the resting area without blocking the path. They checked it regularly because a convenient bin that overflowed would create another problem. Litter decreased. The solution combined an understanding of actual movement with a practical maintenance routine.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：篇章结构与信息判断

readings.title: Repairing the tap no one owned
readings.instruction: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A dripping tap stood between a sports field and a community garden. Garden members assumed the sports club maintained it; the club thought it belonged to the garden. Several people mentioned the leak, but no request reached the town maintenance team. At a joint meeting, the groups agreed that either side could report a fault and that one person would track the request. A small label displayed the reporting contact. The tap was repaired the following week. The groups learned that noticing a shared problem does not ensure action when responsibility is left unclear.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：篇章结构与信息判断

readings.title: Comparing energy use fairly
readings.instruction: Read the passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: An office celebrated a fall in monthly electricity use after installing efficient lights. An employee pointed out that the office had also closed for a week during that month. The facilities team compared daily use on working days and checked the same period the previous year. The lights still appeared to save energy, but the improvement was smaller than the original monthly total suggested. The team published the revised estimate and explained the difference. A fair comparison helped managers decide where further investment would be useful without giving the lighting project credit for days when the building was empty.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：篇章结构与信息判断

translation.stem:
Translate the following passage into Chinese:
Many public projects are remembered for the day they begin. Yet their success often depends on quiet work that continues afterwards. A new tree needs care, a convenient bin needs emptying, and a reported fault needs someone to follow it up. Planning these responsibilities from the start makes an improvement more likely to last. Without that planning, a good first impression may quickly fade.
knowledgePoints: 英译汉：语义准确与中文表达
translation.explanation: 注意yet转折、三个并列例子以及make ... more likely to结构。
translation.referenceAnswer: 许多公共项目因启动那一天而被人记住。然而，它们的成功往往取决于此后持续进行的默默无闻的工作。新栽的树需要照料，方便使用的垃圾桶需要清空，已经报告的故障需要有人跟进。从一开始就规划这些责任，更有可能让改进持续下去。缺少这样的规划，良好的第一印象可能很快就会消失。

writing.stem: Write 100–150 words in English to a community group after a tree-planting event. Propose a follow-up care plan, explain how responsibilities could be shared, and suggest how progress should be recorded.
knowledgePoints: 写作：任务完成、组织与语言
writing.explanation: 具体交代后续养护、分工和记录方式。
writing.sampleAnswer:
Dear group members,
Our planting day was enjoyable, but the young trees will need attention after the photographs have been shared. I suggest making a simple care plan for the next six months.
We could divide the path into three sections and assign a small volunteer team to each. Teams would check the trees regularly, note damaged supports or heavy weeds, and contact the coordinator when extra help is needed. Volunteers should follow the gardener's advice about any work they undertake.
A shared record could show each tree's location, the date of the visit and the action required or completed. At the end of summer, we could report how the trees are doing and what we have learned. This would help our efforts produce a lasting improvement.
Best wishes,
A volunteer
